# Chapter 56 – Naming Ceremony

Scene 1. The settlement holds a naming ceremony blending Earth customs and new local ritual.

Scene 2. Gabriel records the event as the day the colony stopped being only an argument.

Scene 3. Even the survivalists are moved.

Scene 4. Elena begins to imagine leadership after herself.

Scene 5. A new transmission arrives from Earth. Bridge: Earth’s voice returns at the precise moment Mars has created its own.

PART VIII – THE CITY UNDER DUST
